Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling northbound on a two-lane road approaching the intersection in Conroe, Texas, when Driver 2
entered from a side street and struck the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle. The impact was a side-impact collision,
and the damage to both vehicles is consistent with the reported point of contact. Driver 1 reported neck and back
strain at the scene and was transported for evaluation. Passenger was seated in the front right position and was also
observed at the scene. Responding officers reviewed scene photographs, which confirm several details of the vehicle
positions and debris field. No independent witnesses were located who saw the collision itself. Officers found no
indication of prior damage to either vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle
involved. Based on the physical evidence and the reported forces, the injuries described appear consistent with the
mechanics of this crash. No citations were issued at the time of this report, and the investigation remains open
pending further statements.
